[engine] kernel_cgc_ids_capture is a generic 'copy up to `stride` int32 words from buffer 1 into slot N of buffer 2' kernel -- it has nothing ids-specific in it. Pointing the instrument at a tensor OUTPUT therefore needs no new kernel, no new kargs and no new pipeline: only a second destination buffer with a wider stride and a second submission site.

**class**: `source-reading`

## 為什麼（because）

Reading the kernel instead of assuming an ids-capture kernel must be special-cased saved .metal, ggml-metal-impl.h, ggml-metal-device.{h,cpp} and ggml-metal-context.m entirely -- the whole extension is one file (ggml-metal-ops.cpp) plus a three-line env allowlist. It also kept the existing comparator usable unchanged, because the row format is the same.

## 反例（counterexample_observed）

extension touched: ggml-metal-ops.cpp (new cgc_submit/cgc_dst_capture/capture_init + seq merge), ggml-metal-ops.h (comment), run_server.sh (allowlist). Unchanged: ggml-metal.metal, ggml-metal-impl.h, ggml-metal-device.h/.cpp/.m, ggml-metal-context.m.

- `src/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-metal/ggml-metal-ops.cpp`
